concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-webhooks-transaction-node]] - Node.js ACH and SEPA Direct Debit transaction settlement notification kinds, qualified post-settled decline wording, and damaged availability/attribute-rendering boundaries
warnings: Retain only the explicit ACH and SEPA Direct Debit availability; do not reconstruct the malformed `Direct Debitandrequests` text or infer support for all transaction payment methods.

Preserve the page's unusual phrase that the customer's bank `returns the refund after it has appeared to settle`; do not silently normalize it into a general bank-return, reversal, or payment-finality rule.
The Attributes section exposes only concatenated categories with no visible field names; do not invent attribute identifiers or a complete payload schema.

No material conflict was found with the existing overview: it routes ACH transaction-status webhooks but does not exclude SEPA. Do not import universal delivery, ordering, retry, duplication, parsing, or finality claims.
